name: Haus Margreth
beschreibung: The Haus Margreth welcomes visitors to the scenic hamlet of Plangeroß in St. Leonhard im Pitztal, framed by the soaring peaks of the Ötztal Alps. The comfortably furnished guest rooms include private en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, and partial balconies offering direct vistas of snow-capped summits. A hearty breakfast featuring regional specialities provides the perfect start to an active morning. Scenic hiking trails and mountaineering routes leading to alpine huts start right at the doorstep. In winter, the free ski bus stops just moments away, whisking guests up to the high-altitude Pitztal Glacier and the Rifflsee ski resort.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy guesthouse in Plangeroß in St. Leonhard im Pitztal offering views of the Pitztal Glacier and easy access to mountain lifts.
